name: Ideogram
label: Ideogram
description: Official Ideogram Image API (v4 generate, async poll, remix, upscale) at https://api.ideogram.ai. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth is StudioQuack secret api_key as header Api-Key. Image payloads use type file. Docs: https://developer.ideogram.ai/api-reference/api-reference. Ephemeral result URLs expire — download if you need to keep them. Never log api_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: generate: prompt or json_prompt (mutually exclusive). generate_async returns generation_id — poll get_task. remix requires image (type file) + prompt. upscale requires image (type file) + image_request. Do not put api_key here. Example: {"prompt":"a bold poster"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: EXACT: generate | generate_async | get_task | remix | upscale. Blank: infer from generation_id / image+prompt, else config.

schema.label: prompt
schema.description: Natural-language prompt for generate / generate_async / remix (Ideogram v2 field). Mutually exclusive with json_prompt on generate. Example: a bold poster.

schema.label: image
schema.description: Platform file ref-id for remix or upscale (JPEG/WebP/PNG, max 25MB). Never inline bytes.

schema.label: generation_id
schema.description: URL-safe id from generate_async for get_task. Status: pending | completed | failed.

schema.label: json_prompt
schema.description: Request-body parameter `json_prompt` for operations: generate, generate_async.

schema.label: resolution
schema.description: Request-body parameter `resolution` for operations: generate, generate_async, remix.

schema.label: rendering_speed
schema.description: Request-body parameter `rendering_speed` for operations: generate, generate_async, remix.

schema.label: enable_copyright_detection
schema.description: Request-body parameter `enable_copyright_detection` for operations: generate, generate_async, remix.

schema.label: image_request
schema.description: upscale: JSON string for multipart field image_request (e.g. {"resemblance":50,"detail":90}). Required with image.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (urls in data[] or generation_id). is_image_safe=false means empty url. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (created, data[].url, generation_id, poll status).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: EXACT: generate | generate_async | get_task | remix | upscale. Default generate = synchronous POST /v1/ideogram-v4/generate. Poll with get_task after generate_async.

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: Ideogram developer API key. Sent as header Api-Key. StudioQuack secret. Never logged. Setup: https://developer.ideogram.ai/ideogram-api/api-setup

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: HTTP timeout. Default 120. Floor 1. Use generate_async + get_task instead of raising this for long jobs.
